es: Usar recommend, suggest, propose e insist con el patrón correcto: -ing o that + sujeto + verbo base.

teaching.en: We recommend that the council approve the budget before the fifth of this month, since the stage must be booked before the prices rise again.
teaching.es: Recomendamos que el consejo apruebe el presupuesto antes del día cinco de este mes, ya que hay que reservar el escenario antes de que los precios vuelvan a subir.
teaching.explanationEs: Recommend that + sujeto + verbo base: approve, sin -s aunque el sujeto sea singular.
segments: We recommend that the council approve the budget before the fifth of this
month, since the stage must be booked before the prices rise again.
teaching.audioText: We recommend that the council approve the budget before the fifth of this month, since the stage must be booked before the prices rise again.

teaching.en: Mia and I suggest postponing the concert until the weather improves, but the chair would rather suggest that the committee postpone the vote until Friday.
teaching.es: Mia y yo sugerimos aplazar el concierto hasta que mejore el tiempo, pero el presidente prefiere sugerir que el comité aplace la votación hasta el viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Suggest admite -ing (sin nuevo sujeto) o that + sujeto + verbo base, nunca to + infinitivo.
segments: Mia and I suggest postponing the concert until the weather improves, but the
chair would rather suggest that the committee postpone the vote until Friday.
teaching.audioText: Mia and I suggest postponing the concert until the weather improves, but the chair would rather suggest that the committee postpone the vote until Friday.

teaching.en: The rules stipulate that every volunteer wear a badge, and it is imperative that nobody enter the stage area without one.
teaching.es: Las normas estipulan que cada voluntario lleve una credencial, y es imprescindible que nadie entre en la zona del escenario sin ella.
teaching.explanationEs: Stipulate that e it is imperative that piden forma base: wear, enter, sin -s ni -ed.
segments: The rules stipulate that every volunteer wear a badge, and it
is imperative that nobody enter the stage area without one.
teaching.audioText: The rules stipulate that every volunteer wear a badge, and it is imperative that nobody enter the stage area without one.

teaching.en: It is advisable that visitors arrive early, and we propose that the gates open at noon so that the queues stay short.
teaching.es: Es aconsejable que los visitantes lleguen temprano, y proponemos que las puertas abran al mediodía para que las colas sean cortas.
teaching.explanationEs: It is advisable that + sujeto + forma base: un consejo más suave que imperative.
segments: It is advisable that visitors arrive early, and we propose that
the gates open at noon so that the queues stay short.
teaching.audioText: It is advisable that visitors arrive early, and we propose that the gates open at noon so that the queues stay short.

teaching.en: We insist on a written contract, and we insist that every sponsor sign it before the posters are printed.
teaching.es: Exigimos un contrato por escrito, y exigimos que cada patrocinador lo firme antes de imprimir los carteles.
teaching.explanationEs: Insist on + nombre o -ing; insist that + sujeto + forma base. Insist to + infinitivo no existe.
segments: We insist on a written contract, and we insist that
every sponsor sign it before the posters are printed.
teaching.audioText: We insist on a written contract, and we insist that every sponsor sign it before the posters are printed.

teaching.en: It is essential that the stage be ready by Friday, so the residents call for a daily inspection until the gates open.
teaching.es: Es esencial que el escenario esté listo para el viernes, así que los vecinos reclaman una inspección diaria hasta que se abran las puertas.
teaching.explanationEs: It is essential that… pide be en lugar de is; call for + nombre = reclamar o pedir algo.
segments: It is essential that the stage be ready by Friday, so
the residents call for a daily inspection until the gates open.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta: «Recomendamos que el consejo apruebe el plan.»

choices.text: We recommend that the council approves the plan.
We recommend that the council approve the plan.
We recommend the council to approve the plan.

feedback.es: Tras recommend that el verbo va en forma base (approve), aunque el sujeto sea singular; recommend no admite «the council to approve».

hint.es: Fíjate en el verbo después de «the council»: ¿lleva -s?

origin.text: At the planning meeting, the chair asked each member for advice on the safety of the festival. One member wrote this sentence in the minutes.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia sugiere aplazar el concierto hasta la semana que viene.»

feedback.es: Suggest admite -ing cuando no hay nuevo sujeto: suggests postponing, nunca «suggests to postpone».

hint.es: Tras suggest, el verbo va en forma -ing.

origin.text: The forecast is very poor for Saturday, and the stage has no roof. Mia suggests ___ the concert until next week.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Es imprescindible que nadie entre en la zona del escenario.»

answer.text: It is imperative that nobody enter the stage area

feedback.es: It is imperative that + sujeto + forma base: enter, sin -s.

hint.es: Empieza con la fórmula impersonal y deja el verbo en forma base.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone la presidenta sobre la decisión pendiente.

choices.text: Opening the gates at noon, as Sara proposed.
Adding two more guards before the committee meets again.
Waiting until Friday to decide, once the final price arrives.

feedback.es: La presidenta cierra con «suggested postponing the decision until Friday»; abrir al mediodía lo propuso Sara y los guardias los aconsejó la tesorera.

origin.audio: At the festival committee, the discussion got heated. Sara proposed that the gates open at noon, while Carlos insisted on keeping the original time of two o'clock because the sound check would not finish any earlier. The treasurer stipulated that nobody be admitted without a ticket, and she added that it was advisable to add two extra guards. In the end, the chair suggested postponing the decision until Friday, when the builder would send his final quote.

prompt.es: Completa: «El contrato estipula que cada escenario sea inspeccionado antes de abrir.»

feedback.es: Tras stipulate that el verbo va en forma base: be inspected, no is inspected.

origin.text: The council is strict about safety at open-air events. The contract stipulates that every stage ___ inspected before the gates open.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con lo que expresa el autor.

pairs: We insist on a written contract.
It is advisable that visitors arrive early.
We propose that the gates open at noon.
The rules stipulate that volunteers wear a badge.

feedback.es: Insist on exige, advisable aconseja con prudencia, propose plantea una opción y stipulate fija un requisito oficial.

pairs: We insist on a written contract.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Tom. ¿Qué exige el consejo sobre el escenario?

choices.text: An inspection of the structure on the day of the event.
Payment of the insurance on the day of the event.
An inspection of the stage before the fifth of the month.

feedback.es: El consejo pide que el escenario sea inspeccionado el mismo día; el seguro se paga antes del día cinco, que es la otra condición.

origin.audio: Hello, this is Tom from the festival office. I am calling because the council has set two conditions. It stipulates that the organisers pay the insurance before the fifth, and it is imperative that the stage be inspected on the day itself. Personally, I suggest that Mia handle the insurance, but I doubt that we can meet the second condition without postponing the opening by an hour.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez. ¿Qué da a entender Tom sobre la segunda condición?

choices.text: That Mia will refuse to handle the insurance in time.
That meeting it could make the opening later than planned.
That the council may cancel the condition before Friday.

feedback.es: Tom duda de poder cumplirla «without postponing the opening by an hour»: cumplirla probablemente retrasará la apertura.

origin.audio: Hello, this is Tom from the festival office. I am calling because the council has set two conditions. It stipulates that the organisers pay the insurance before the fifth, and it is imperative that the stage be inspected on the day itself. Personally, I suggest that Mia handle the insurance, but I doubt that we can meet the second condition without postponing the opening by an hour.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los vecinos insisten en una hora de cierre a las diez.»

feedback.es: Insist on + nombre es la colocación para exigir algo: insist on a closing time.

origin.text: The neighbours are worried about the noise. They insist ___ a closing time of ten o'clock for every concert.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Es aconsejable que todos lleguen temprano.»

answer.text: It is advisable that everyone arrive early

feedback.es: It is advisable that + sujeto + forma base: arrive, aunque everyone sea singular.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud muestra la autora ante el retraso de la votación?

choices.text: Ready to sign tonight if the members prefer to decide.
Against any decision being taken before the end of the month.
Firm that nothing be signed yet, but open about the date.

feedback.es: Pide con firmeza no firmar aún («advisable that nothing be signed») pero es flexible con la fecha («I do not insist on Friday»).

origin.text: Dear committee, I recommend that we postpone the vote, although I understand that some members would prefer to decide tonight. Since the insurance company has not replied, it is advisable that nothing be signed before we know the terms. I do not insist on Friday, but I would call for a decision by the end of the month.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato. ¿Con qué fin proponen los organizadores un voluntario para las salidas?

choices.text: To prevent another blocked exit during the event.
To avoid paying a fine for the delivery van.
To answer the official's request for more volunteers.

feedback.es: La propuesta responde al problema de la puerta bloqueada: un responsable fijo evitará que se repita; el texto no habla de multas ni de pedir voluntarios.

origin.audio: Last week the festival was almost closed down. The council had stipulated that the exits be kept clear at all times, but during the sound check a delivery van blocked the main gate. Nobody was hurt, yet an official insisted on a written apology and called for a full safety review. The organisers now propose that one volunteer be responsible for the exits throughout the event.

prompt.es: Completa: «Piensan reclamar una revisión completa antes de abrir las puertas.»

feedback.es: Call for + nombre significa reclamar o pedir públicamente algo.

origin.text: The residents are anxious about safety. They plan to call ___ a full review before the gates open.
